item.title: Duffy Touts High-Speed Racing Event for America’s 250th Anniversary
item.description: Sec. Duffy: “We’re going to celebrate America’s 250th birthday… to think, 190mph down Pennsylvania Avenue. This is going to be wild. The last time we had a race in the Capital City was… a horse race in 1801.”

item.description: CNN Releases Statement on the Arrest of Don Lemon

item.title: Trump Signs Order Launching First-Ever IndyCar Street Race in Washington, D.C.
item.description: President Trump signs Executive Order officially launching the Freedom250 Grand Prix of Washington, D.C. It will be the first-ever Indy Car street race in our nation’s capitol to celebrate America’s 250th birthday.

item.title: Trump Praises Fed Chair Nominee Kevin Warsh, Lauds Hassett’s White House Role
item.description: Trump on Fed Chair Nominee Kevin Warsh: “He’s very smart, very good, strong… and I think he’s going to do good… I wanted to keep Kevin [Hassett] here… Kevin really has been fantastic at the White House.”

item.title: BREAKING: IDF Launches Multiple Airstrikes on Hezbollah Targets in Southern Lebanon
item.description: BREAKING: The IDF says Israeli jets are carrying out multiple airstrikes on Hezbollah targets across southern Lebanon, with Lebanese media reporting at least 10 strikes.

item.title: DOJ’s Blanche Says No Comment Yet on Don Lemon Arrest Pending Charges
item.description: Deputy Attorney General Todd Blanche on Don Lemon arrest: “Do I have a reaction to it? I don’t know what that means. What are you looking for to do, jump up and down? No, I don’t have a reaction to it. I don’t know that the charges have been unsealed yet.”

item.title: Schumer Calls Don Lemon Arrest “Dark Message” for Journalists
item.description: Sen. Schumer on Don Lemon arrest: “The arrest is a dark message to journalists everywhere. If you dare criticize this administration, watch your back…Don Lemon should be released at once, and the frivolous charges against him dropped.”

item.title: Graham Defends ICE, Calls Out GOP Leaders Over Attacks on Federal Agents
item.description: Sen. Lindsey Graham: “The ICE agents and the border patrol and all federal law enforcement involved in this has been slandered and smeared. To the Republican Party, where have you been? Count me in for holding them accountable. Where are you at leaders?”
